meta.perspective: Every node is seen from Ana's side; mirror is the same physical position from the opponent's side. An edge is a move done by the side standing on 'from'. The opponent's options at node X are the edges from mirror(X), landing at mirror(ok) / mirror(bad). One table serves both athletes.

keys.bad: where a miss lands when the defender owns an answer (else the walk stays)
keys.points: IBJJF points the edge scores (its own score + the landing node's reach_points; BeltRoad.POINTS)
keys.bad_gives: points a miss hands the other side
keys.answers: defender moves whose mastery stops this edge
keys.gm_pose: GrappleMap position ids for the node card (card_pose = the first)
keys.finish_w: chooser prior: share of visits that end in a tap (Grappling Conjecture 2024/25); also checked as an output. back_top 0.36 is UNVERIFIED (no source found, John S384) and is a tuning value set by bar 6
keys.ibjjf_min: lowest belt allowed under IBJJF no-gi adult rules (re-check in stage 1)

meta.unlock_rule: Positions are free. Owning a move (mastery >= BeltRoad.OWNED_AT 30) owns every edge with that move id; a FELT move (15-29, r2) is used in opens at mf = m/30; a learning move (under 15) is never tried in an open. BASE moves are everyone's at 100. A hole = a node where the side owns no non-BASE out-edge.
meta.sources: Structure from two public BJJ charts (S384 tmp files, not shipped) and BJJ fact; every name here is ours. Poses and film ids from assets/grapplemap/graph.json.

ana_start.note: tree moves of her belt start at OWNED_AT x mat_classes / CLASSES_TO_NEXT = 30 x 130/200 = 19.5
